It then sets `camera.limits` to the mode's object and clamps the current pose once, since the notes say changing limits doesn't re-clamp on its own. The mode's limits object is only read, never changed.

- **`_setOrientation`:** I replaced it on the camera instance. Any library code that captured the old function, or that writes fields directly (possibly `setGeospatialOrientation`), bypasses the clamp.
